name: Team Bulbasaur: Infernal Thaw & Fighting Wallbreakers
archetype: 4x Fire and 4x Fighting super-effective sweepers with Thick Fat Ice spongeing.
gym_duel_rationale: Pryce's 5v5 ice hockey duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Venusaur/Charizard anchors the front line, firing STAB Flamethrower to instantly incinerate Mamoswine/Bastiodon with 4x super-effective heat while melting Dewgong/Slowking and Jynx/Wailord with Petal Dance; Kingler/Primeape enters the duel core to unleash devastating 4x STAB Close Combat against both Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster, while dousing Infernape/Weavile with Crabhammer; Gyarados/Arbok applies Intimidate to blunt physical assault and crunches psychic water hybrids; Alakazam/Weezing shreds Infernape/Weavile with STAB Psychic while avoiding Earthquake via Levitate; and Snorlax utilizes Thick Fat to halve all incoming Ice moves, comfortably spongeing Blizzards and Surfs with Rest and Leftovers sustain.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 67. STAB Flamethrower deals catastrophic 4x damage to Mamoswine/Bastiodon, while Petal Dance melts Water hybrids.

roster.status: Active in Party (Rotated into Duel Core)
roster.progression_notes: 500 BST physical juggernaut elevated to Lv. 66. STAB Close Combat delivers crushing 4x super-effective blows to Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts physical attack on switch-in. STAB Crunch deals heavy damage to Dewgong/Slowking and Jynx/Wailord.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake via Levitate. STAB Psychic cleanly executes Infernape/Weavile.
Colossal 160 HP fortress. Thick Fat cuts all incoming Ice damage by 50%, completely walling Pryce's Blizzard artillery while sustaining with Rest.

roster.status: Active in Party (Benched for Gym Duel)
roster.progression_notes: Aerial transit scout. Benched for Pryce's 5v5 duel due to Ice vulnerability, but handles Route 42 and Route 43 wild encounters.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route trainers.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen against opposing aerial foes.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
